data.text: Luke, I appreciate the offer, but I’d rather we protect both the lake and a fair income for all five of us. My family has fished here for generations; keeping it healthy matters to the whole village. I propose 10 tons each this month and the same going forward while the lake starts at 100. That earns everyone $10,000 a month and leaves 50 tons to replenish the lake fully. Your plan gives us four a short-term bonus, but leaves you with much less and requires another agreement to restore the stock. I’m willing to choose 10 under a shared agreement. John, would you support that?
